status: frozen before any round-2 result was computed; round-1 results (results.json) are known and motivated these changes
purpose: Development round on the spent Rome AD 150 / Han AD 2 Earth pools: fix the two causes found in round 1, choose one reach rule, then test the chosen chain blind on unseen pools declared in a separate plan (plan_blind.json) before any atlas default changes.
data_status: Development use of seen data (dataset_usage.json id earth_control_rome150_han2). Selection here is not evidence of skill; only the blind test can promote a default.

changes.L1_rural_ledger: In equilibrium the rural population is what the regime's harvest feeds, so the fixed rural claim becomes 0.6 x produced (= 0.6 x F x reference production) instead of 0.6 x reference. The fixed claim stays the rule for short-term shocks (the labour cases); a fertility regime is a long-run state. Applied to joint365 (F = 1, identical to round 1), fert_bare and fert_legume.

reach_rules.P0: Round-1 rule: paired 2-day patrols from staffed sources, held in all 12 monthly bins (administrative month graph).
reach_rules.P1: Year-round effective days (polity.control.effective_days over the 12 monthly networks of the legacy map) <= 2.0 from staffed sources only.
reach_rules.P2: P1 plus road cells as sources where the road cell itself is within 2.0 year-round days of a staffed source (roads maintained from staffed towns).
reach_rules.P3: P1 plus every road cell as a source (the legacy map with food-filtered towns).

changes.note: Han has no road data, so P2 and P3 equal P1 there.

unchanged: Everything else as plan.json: sources, windows, bands, collection, stores, allocation, census errors (fert_bare 0.459, joint365 0.538, fert_legume 0.685), M1 balanced accuracy, M2 staffed share.

selection.R_star: The reach rule with the highest balanced accuracy averaged over Rome (whole band), Han and the three food cases under L1.
selection.report: Every rule x case x ledger (fixed and scaled) result, legacy_0 and reference, TPR / TNR, staffed shares.
selection.carried_to_blind_test: R_star with L1; the three food cases; legacy_0 as the comparison. The blind plan applies the round-1 gates G1 (>= 75 % of real sources staffed) and G2 (BA >= legacy_0 - 0.02) per pool and the census-error choice among passing cases.
